stem: What does President Bill Clinton’s impeachment trial reflect about modern U.S. politics?

options.label: A
options.text: Congress conducts more thorough investigations of judicial nominees.

options.label: B
options.text: Campaign finances are monitored by a regulatory agency.

options.label: C
options.text: Media outlets focus more on policy issues than on the actions of elected officials.

options.label: D
options.text: Elected officials face greater scrutiny of their personal lives.
